articles.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants U.S. open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
articles.summary: Tan argues that frontier models themselves trained on public human knowledge so access to capable AI should be "a form of public good."

articles.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
articles.summary: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter arguing that AI labs are threatening their intellectual work.
